To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the interfacially improved eco-composites with good mechanical properties can be prepared by adding PBAT to PLA/T-PF eco-composites.
the interfacal adhesion between PLA and PF is improved by the titanate treatment and the toughness is enhanced by PBAT.
the mechanical properties of the composites can be improved by titanate treatment of PF and addition of PBAT.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the preparation and the properties of the PLA/PF/PBAT eco-composites and the effect of T-PF on the mechanical properties, morphologies and crystallization behaviors.
the development of eco-composites with a high content of renewable resources.
the influence of T-PF and PBAT on the structure, morphology and properties of PLA/PBAT/PF eco-composite.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the mechanical properties, crystallization behaviors of PLA/PF/PBAT eco-composites are influenced by the PF, PBAT and titanate treatment.
the addition of T-PF and PBAT to PLA can improve the mechanical properties of the eco-composite and the toughness is improved by the addition of PBAT.
the eco-composites of PLA/PF and PLA/PF/PBAT are promising for industrial applications.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the addition of T-PF and PBAT into PLA can improve the mechanical properties and crystallization of the composites.
the addition of T-PF and PBAT can improve the mechanical properties of the eco-composite and the addition of PBAT can improve its toughness.
the addition of T-PF and PBAT can improve the toughness of PLA and the addition of PF can improve the stiffness of PLA.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the addition of T-PF and PBAT can enhance the mechanical properties of the eco-composite.
the eco-composites can be improved by adding PBAT and treating PF with a titanate coupling agents.
the eco-composites have potential applications in packaging, agriculture and construction.
